V0608_01_00_00_0.text:
As you wish.
I challenge you to a Duel!

V0608_01_00_01_0.text: I am not one that will easily be defeated!

V0608_01_00_02_0.text: If you won't back down, neither will I!

V0608_01_00_03_0.text: It seems we are left with no other choice but to Duel!

V0608_01_00_04_0.text: I will always fight for those I love!

V0608_01_00_05_0.text: If Playmaker is my opponent, I must give it my all!

V0608_01_00_06_0.text: Show me how strong you are, Skye!

V0608_01_00_07_0.text: I didn't expect I'd have to fight you, Mr. Gore.

V0608_01_00_08_0.text: I know more than anyone how dangerous you can be, Ghost Gal.

V0608_01_00_09_0.text: The Shepherd is a true professional among professionals.

V0608_01_00_10_0.text:
They say the Ignis are a threat to humanity.
Is that true?

V0608_01_00_11_0.text: I can't allow you to hurt anyone anymore, Bohman!

V0608_03_00_00_0.text: Though you may not say it out loud, your moves admit defeat!

V0608_03_00_01_0.text: This turn will be your last!

V0608_03_00_03_0.text: I will do what I must do!

V0608_03_00_04_0.text: Now is the time to make my stand!

V0608_03_00_05_0.text: I need to change my strategy if I want to win!

V0608_05_00_00_0.text:
This draw will decide everything...
Time to face my destiny!

V0608_07_09_00_0.text: I flip over my Set card!

V0608_07_09_01_0.text: This is the card I Set!

V0608_08_00_00_0.text:
I activate my Field Spell!
Euler's Circuit!

V0608_08_00_02_0.text: I activate Euler's Circuit's effect from my Graveyard!

V0608_08_00_03_0.text: This card will shut down another one of your strategies.

V0608_08_00_03_1.text: I activate the Continuous Spell, Nagel's Protection!

V0608_08_00_04_0.text: I activate Nagel's Protection's effect from my Graveyard!

V0608_08_00_05_0.text: I activate the Continuous Spell, Stairs of Mail!

V0608_08_00_06_0.text: The Continuous Spell, Stairs of Mail's effect!

V0608_08_00_07_0.text: I activate the Trap Card, Tindangle Delaunay!

V0608_08_00_08_0.text: I banish Tindangle Delaunay from my Graveyard!

V0608_08_00_09_0.text:
I activate my Trap Card!
Gergonne's End!

V0608_08_00_09_1.text: I equip this card on my monster!

V0608_09_00_00_0.text: Since Acute Cerberus attacked, its effect activates!

V0608_09_00_02_0.text: Tindangle Hound activates its effect when it's destroyed!

V0608_09_00_04_0.text: Tindangle Intruder activates its effect when it's Summoned!

V0608_09_00_05_0.text: Tindangle Intruder activates its effect from the Graveyard!

V0608_09_00_06_0.text: Dholes was sent from my hand or Deck to the Graveyard!

V0608_09_00_11_0.text: I used Tindangle Trinity to Link Summon another Tindangle!

V0608_09_00_13_0.text: I activate Tindangle Jhrelth's effect from my hand!

V0608_11_01_00_0.text: I Summon a monster in Defense Position!

V0608_11_10_01_0.text: I open the circuit that links us together!

V0608_11_10_02_0.text: I open the circuit that links us together!

V0608_11_10_02_1.text:
I set my monsters in the Link Arrows!
Link the circuit!

V0608_13_00_01_0.text:
Here comes my Link 3 Tindangle monster!
Acute Cerberus!

V0608_13_00_10_0.text: I Special Summon a Tindangle Token!

V0608_16_00_00_0.text: This will be the final attack!

V0608_21_00_00_0.text: The goddess of victory is always on my side!

V0608_21_00_01_0.text:
There is nothing you can do.
That is your fate.

V0608_21_00_04_0.text: If I can't find a way out of this situation, I won't win.

V0608_21_00_05_0.text: Even though luck isn't on my side, I'll fight to the last!

V0608_28_00_00_0.text: It's my duty to protect LINK VRAINS from every threat.

V0608_28_00_01_0.text:
You no longer need to fight.
I will carry on your legacy.

V0608_28_00_02_0.text: Summoning monster after monster won't work against me.

V0608_28_00_03_0.text: My Deck becomes stronger when it faces Link Monsters.

V0608_28_00_04_0.text: I once was a hacker, so I know every Dueling trick.

V0608_28_00_05_0.text: I wish I thanked you sooner…

V0608_28_00_05_1.text: I'm glad to have met you, Playmaker.

V0608_28_00_07_0.text:
How can I stop worrying about you?
You're my only family.

V0608_28_00_08_0.text: I wonder what it would be like to work with you again.

V0608_28_00_09_0.text: Mankind did not make your lives easy...

V0608_28_00_09_1.text:
For that, I can only apologize.
It truly was a tragedy.

V0608_29_00_01_0.text: I didn't know your cards had those effects...

V0608_29_00_02_0.text:
Excellent Dueling.
You proved how skilled you are.

V0608_29_00_03_0.text: A Duelist of your talent should work for SOL Technologies.

V0608_29_00_04_0.text: If I keep Dueling like this, I will be demoted.

V0608_29_00_05_0.text: No Duelist is more determined to win than Playmaker.

V0608_29_00_06_0.text:
Your skills have greatly improved...
I'm proud of you, Skye.

V0608_29_00_07_0.text:
If your heart is set on Dueling...
Just don't lose, Skye!

V0608_29_00_08_0.text: This is why I trust you with my most important missions.

V0608_29_00_09_0.text:
You never let your prey escape.
That's why you're dangerous.

V0608_29_00_10_0.text: The creation has surpassed its creators...

V0608_30_00_00_0.text:
I don't want to fight if I don't have to.
Just back down!

V0608_30_00_01_0.text: Summoning too many monsters in a row depleted your Deck.

V0608_30_00_02_0.text:
You expect me to believe your lies?
I will learn the truth!

V0608_32_00_01_0.text:
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links!
It's time to link into the VRAINS!

V0608_33_00_01_0.text: I also have a way to turn this Duel around!

V0608_33_00_02_0.text: I won't flee from a fight!

V0608_34_00_00_0.text: I have all the time in the world to break you down!

V0608_34_00_01_0.text:
What I did to you was wrong.
But you'll still forgive me?

V0608_34_00_02_0.text: The past is a ball and chain that keeps you from moving on.

V0608_34_00_03_0.text:
Go make new friends.
Do something adventurous.

V0608_34_00_04_0.text: You can do anything when you’re not consumed with revenge.

V0608_34_00_05_0.text: It's never easy, but certain sacrifices need to be made!

V0608_34_00_06_0.text: I'm sure I'll be demoted in the next board meeting.

V0608_34_00_07_0.text: I'm willing to make sacrifices for the greater good.

V0608_34_00_08_0.text: On behalf of SOL Technologies, I offer my apologies.

V0608_34_00_09_0.text: As CEO, I have a responsibility to protect my employees!

V0608_34_00_12_0.text: What did you do to my sister!

V0608_35_00_00_0.text: I am Akira Zaizen - CEO of SOL Technologies.

V0608_35_00_01_0.text: It's time to link into the VRAINS!

V0608_36_00_00_0.text: I'm sure you can handle the rest.

V0608_36_00_02_0.text:
Don't give up!
There must be something you can do!

V0608_36_00_04_0.text: Playmaker, let your bravery be your strength!

V0608_36_00_06_0.text: Keep your eye on the big picture, Playmaker!

V0608_36_00_07_0.text:
Don't focus on saving me.
Focus on winning!

V0608_36_00_08_0.text: Destiny is in your hands, Skye!

V0608_36_00_09_0.text: I know you can do this, Skye!

V0608_36_00_10_0.text:
Stay calm, Skye!
There must be something you can do!

V0608_36_00_11_0.text: Watch out for everything, Ghost Gal!

V0608_36_00_12_0.text: I'm trusting you to win, Ghost Gal!

V0608_36_00_13_0.text:
Ghost Gal...
If you can't save us, no one can.
